$comment: Packages allowed to declare install scripts, with the reason. Each must install WITHOUT Python (proven by `npm run check:toolchain:install`). npm 11 does not run these scripts unless approved via allowScripts; PBE leaves them unapproved because neither is needed. Review every entry when dependencies change.

installScripts.@parcel/watcher: Transitive dependency of Jest (jest-haste-map). Its install script only runs node-gyp when npm_config_build_from_source=true; otherwise it does nothing. The prebuilt binary is installed through its optional platform package (e.g. @parcel/watcher-darwin-arm64). Never set build_from_source for this project.
installScripts.unrs-resolver: Transitive dependency of Jest (jest-resolve). Its postinstall (napi-postinstall) only verifies that the prebuilt N-API binding (@unrs/resolver-binding-*) is present; it does not compile anything.
